_comment: HTP backend-extensions per-graph config for qnn-context-binary-generator. Target: Rokid Neo (qcom,neo / NEO LUNA-V2), aDSP Hexagon v73. vtcm_mb=2 is conservative for Neo (smaller VTCM than 8Gen2-class). hvx_threads=2 matches the 4x A55 CPU pairing; raise to 4 if perf is insufficient once on-device. graph_names lists the four wake-word pipeline stages compiled by compile_onnx_to_qnn.sh.
